subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 7: Skills – Reading (a recipe: Let's cook!)
outcomes: Read a recipe and find information about Rasha and her harees.
Know the parts of a recipe.
Put recipe steps in order with First, Then, After that, Last.

tf.s: Rasha is the winner of the TV show Kids Cook!
It takes 30 minutes to make harees.
The recipe is for ten people.
You need a lot of butter for harees.
tf.why: You need only a little butter.

tf.s: First, you cook the wheat in some water.
tf.why: Great! Cooking the wheat is the first step.

tf.s: You add the spices before the chicken.
tf.why: You add the chicken, and after that the spices.

tf.s: In a recipe, the ingredients come before the instructions.
tf.why: Yes! You get the ingredients before you cook.
She lives with five people: mum, dad, two brothers and her sister.

o: Add a little butter and serve.
boxes.why: Last, you add a little butter and serve.

boxes.q: What do you add after the chicken?
boxes.why: After the chicken, you add the spices.

boxes.q: Which word starts the first step?
What is a list of food you need for a recipe?
boxes.why: Ingredients are the food you need.

boxes.q: What do you cook the wheat in?
boxes.why: You cook the wheat in some water.

boxes.q: Which is NOT an ingredient of harees?
boxes.why: Harees has wheat, chicken, spices and butter, not chocolate.

boxes.q: What tells you what to do, step by step?

mcq.why: Rasha is 10 and won Kids Cook!

mcq.q: How many people is the harees recipe for?
Which is a part of a recipe?
mcq.why: A recipe has a name, time, people, ingredients and instructions.

mcq.q: Put in order: (a) add the spices (b) cook the wheat (c) add butter (d) add the chicken
mcq.why: Wheat, then chicken, then spices, then butter.

mcq.q: Correct the mistake: 'First, you add the butter.'
o: First, you cook the wheat in some water.
mcq.why: The first step is to cook the wheat.

mcq.q: How much butter do you need for harees?
mcq.why: The recipe says a little butter.

mcq.q: Why do the ingredients come before the instructions?
o: You need to get the ingredients before you cook.
You read the recipe after cooking.
mcq.why: You get everything ready first, then you cook.

mcq.q: Why do recipes use First, Then, After that and Last?
o: They show the order of the steps.

mcq.q: You start cooking harees at 5 o'clock. When is it ready?
mcq.why: It takes 30 minutes, so it is ready at half past five.
